BOOK-01.name: Mike Sudler
BOOK-01.bio: This 1st installment of a 10 Volume set contains a variety of poetry collaborations using a Hip Hop Lyrical flow to voice the views and opinions of various artists from many walks of life. Don't miss out on what many others are reading get your copy now.

BOOK-02.name: THE FIRM DIVAS
BOOK-02.bio: We are The Ladies of The Lyricist Firm. We are Mothers, lovers, survivors, writers, poets and storytellers. We are creators of art, with our love for poetry we share our voice. Through our writing we bring our hearts, our lows and our triumphs. We bring a unique bond, women from all over the country different ages, different walks of life, we all come with a great love and respect for one another we come together as sisters, we come together as The Firm Divas!!!

BOOK-03.name: WE GO HARD, YOU GO HOME
BOOK-03.bio: The second collaborative poetry book by The Lyricist Firm Family. We produce writes of poetry in a lyrical style format and hit on a variety of topics bring you a selectable taste of enjoyable reads for your enjoyment.

BOOK-04.name: PAGE BURNERS
BOOK-04.bio: A Firm collection and collaboration of short stories by a few of the best authors of The Lyricist Firm who brought you The Firm Fam', The Firm Divas and Firm Erotica. This book is a great read to add to your collection of our past and future books... don't miss out!!!

BOOK-05.name: FIRM EROTICA
BOOK-05.bio: Another project of The Lyricist Firm from 1 of our other groups called Firm Erotica. This Volume brings poetry and shortstories to another level of realness within our organization. Understand that this is EROTIC, so the language her is very graphic. What we produce is for entertainment purposes only so enjoy.

BOOK-11.name: Mike Sudler
BOOK-11.bio: Capital Punishment is a drama story that takes place in Wilmington, Delaware. A young high school student unnoticed by many finds an incredible love in the oddest of places at the most inconvenient time. They happen to hook up and before long she is pregnant. As the boys grow up they develop their own separate characters and personalities leading them down two different paths just to end up at the same place. School is hard work and so is the street life. With the drug crack hitting the streets so hard, it claims many lives, both by substance abuse and murder. Will this teen have the strength to overcome all obstacles or be swallowed up by what this world rejects?
